summary: Completed comprehensive testing of simplified RepLedger MVP focusing on core features: JWT auth, API key management, and Agent CRUD. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly. Backend simplified to remove outcomes, scoring, and badges as per new spec.
passed_tests: User signup with email/password returns JWT token
User login with email/password returns JWT token
POST /api/api-key/regenerate creates new key and revokes old
POST /api/v1/agents creates agent with {name, description?, owner_handle?}
POST /api/v1/agents returns only {agent_id, name, description, owner_handle, created_at}
GET /api/v1/agents lists user's agents with correct format
All v1 endpoints require Authorization header (JWT or API key)
API key authentication works for all v1 endpoints
Frontend signup flow with email/password/confirm password
Dashboard shows API key with copy functionality
Dashboard shows agents section with empty state
New Agent dialog with form fields (name required, description optional, owner_handle optional)
Agent creation through frontend creates agent and updates table
Agents table displays agent data (name, agent_id, created_at)
User session management and logout functionality
